sloka: ततस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे श्रुत्वा लङ्काधिपस्य तत्।वचनं सर्वमातिष्ठन् यथावत्तु महाबलाः ।। ६.७२.१७ ।।
transliteration: tataste rākṣasāḥ sarve śrutvā laṅkādhipasya tat।vacanaṁ sarvamātiṣṭhan yathāvattu mahābalāḥ ।। 6.72.17 ।।

translations.english: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, enjoined the Rakshasas and himself bearing the thorn of wrath, entered the abode desperately.
